expression_comparison.chosen_because: Price, inflation revisions, and policy line up on UST 5Y in a way AUDNZD, USDSEK, the 2s10s flattener, and CA-US RV do not. Curve flatteners and receive-CA RV both require a long-duration leg against markets that are themselves in yield uptrends. AUDNZD is the stretched spot trend mean-reverters will fade, but NZ rates are missing and AU housing is an unconfirmed but real AUD risk, so it is the second-best continuation rather than the cleanest. Vol is not competitive versus a liquid outright yield trend.

considered_rates.assessment: Cleanest continuation. UST 5Y 4.78% as of 2026-09-17 is pctile_1y 98.41 / pctile_5y 98.81 with bp_1m +41 and bp_3m +51. UST 2Y is even stronger on 1m (+48bp, pctile_1y 99.21) but only pctile_5y 83.93, so 5Y better owns the persistent higher-for-longer trend rather than just the front-end hike. Price, inflation revisions, and the delivered Fed hike are aligned. The 1d -8bp dip is the fade this seat rejects.

Real but inferior. US 2s10s is 27bp as of 2026-09-17, pctile_1y 1.39, chg_1m -25bp; 5s10s is 16bp, pctile_1y 0.60. That is a persistent bear-flatten (2Y +48bp 1m vs 10Y +23bp). A flattener is long 10Y against a 10Y that is itself pctile_5y 99.40 and +45bp 3m, so the long-end leg fights the outright yield trend. Do not squeeze the last flattening basis points when outright belly still trends.

Strong relative trend, still not cleaner. CA-US 2Y is -139bp as of 2026-09-16, pctile_1y 4.76 / pctile_5y 4.67, chg_1m -17bp, chg_5d -12bp. US gauges are hotter than Canada, and Canada core is near 2% with labor 38. But CA 2Y itself is pctile_1y 99.01 and +38bp 1m / +60bp 3m, so receiving CA fights Canada's own yield uptrend. BoC energy pass-through risk is a concrete CA-hawkish reversal. AU-US 2Y at +40.5bp is only pctile_1y 47 and AU yields are 8 days stale. NZ-US and AU-NZ RV are unavailable.

considered_spot.assessment: Best raw price trend in the FX snapshot, but not the cleaner expression. AUDNZD spot 1.2388 as of 2026-09-17 is pctile_1y 99.80 / pctile_5y 99.96, z_5y 2.96, with ret_1d/5d/1m all positive. Relative gauges favor AUD over NZD on labor and activity, and housing plus the India deal have not broken price. Still reject it versus UST 5Y: NZ official rates are unavailable so the usual AUDNZD rate-differential trend cannot be confirmed; AU housing is a live tightening-channel risk even without a price break; ECB reference crosses are not executable. USDSEK (pctile_1y 99.80, ret_1m +3.21%) and USDCHF (pctile_1y 99.80, positive 1d through 3m) are 1y USD/CHF-SEK trends, not 5y trends (pctile_5y 40 and 27). Spot is a valid continuation sleeve, not the aligned one.
